item.description:
Accepted to the SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Track, GaussiAnimate is a scaffold-skin rigging system for reconstructing and animating diverse categories from 4D Gaussian or mesh sequences.

It introduces the skelebone representation and Partwise Motion Matching for controllable yet expressive reanimation. The project page includes the paper, teaser, method overview, and extensive qualitative results.

item.title: GaussiAnimate: Reconstruct and Rig Animatable Categories with Level of Dynamics
item.description: GaussiAnimate compresses the level of dynamics of a 4D shape into compact skelebones that remain both controllable and expressive. See the for the method and qualitative results.

item.title: Neural Radiance Fields with Hash-Low-Rank Decomposition
item.description: HashRF uses hash-low-rank decomposition to allocate representation capacity efficiently, preserving high-frequency scene details with a compact parameter budget.

item.title: GGAvatar: Dynamic Facial Geometric Adjustment for Gaussian Head Avatar
item.description: GGAvatar reconstructs high-fidelity animatable Gaussian head avatars from monocular RGB video. Its geometry-aware coarse-to-fine design improves both novel-view rendering and expression animation.

Math

Hugo Blox Builder supports a Markdown extension for $\LaTeX$ math. Enable math by setting the math: true option in your page’s front matter, or enable math for your entire site by toggling math in your config/_default/params.yaml file:

features:
  math:
    enable: true

To render inline or block math, wrap your LaTeX math with $...$ or $$...$$, respectively.

Example math block:

$$
\gamma_{n} = \frac{ \left | \left (\mathbf x_{n} - \mathbf x_{n-1} \right )^T \left [\nabla F (\mathbf x_{n}) - \nabla F (\mathbf x_{n-1}) \right ] \right |}{\left \|\nabla F(\mathbf{x}_{n}) - \nabla F(\mathbf{x}_{n-1}) \right \|^2}
$$

renders as

$$\gamma_{n} = \frac{ \left | \left (\mathbf x_{n} - \mathbf x_{n-1} \right )^T \left [\nabla F (\mathbf x_{n}) - \nabla F (\mathbf x_{n-1}) \right ] \right |}{\left \|\nabla F(\mathbf{x}_{n}) - \nabla F(\mathbf{x}_{n-1}) \right \|^2}$$

Example inline math $\nabla F(\mathbf{x}_{n})$ renders as $\nabla F(\mathbf{x}_{n})$.

Example multi-line math using the math linebreak (\\):

$$f(k;p_{0}^{*}) = \begin{cases}p_{0}^{*} & \text{if }k=1, \\
1-p_{0}^{*} & \text{if }k=0.\end{cases}$$

renders as

$$ f(k;p_{0}^{*}) = \begin{cases}p_{0}^{*} & \text{if }k=1, \\ 1-p_{0}^{*} & \text{if }k=0.\end{cases} $$

Code

Hugo Blox Builder utilises Hugo’s Markdown extension for highlighting code syntax. The code theme can be selected in the config/_default/params.yaml file.

data.head()

          <h2 class="title is-4">Abstract</h2>
          <div class="content has-text-justified">
            <p>
              Rigging animatable characters, such as quadrupeds and clothed humans, presents a fundamental challenge:
              balancing <i>intuitive control</i> with <i>deformation fidelity</i>. While kinematic skeletons offer
              intuitive control, natural surface deformations involve significant non-rigid dynamics—such as loose
              clothing and soft tissues—that cannot be easily captured by skeletons alone.
              Free-form bones that conform closely to the surface can effectively capture non-rigid deformations
              but lack a kinematic structure necessary for intuitive control.
              Combining the two provides both deformation fidelity and intuitive control.
              We therefore propose a Scaffold-Skin Rigging System, termed <i>skelebones</i>, with three core steps:
              (1) <i>Bones</i>: compress temporally-consistent deformable Gaussians into free-form bones, approximating
              non-rigid surface deformations;
              (2) <i>Skeleton</i>: extract a Mean Curvature Skeleton from canonical Gaussians and refine it temporally,
              ensuring a category-agnostic, motion-adaptive, and topology-correct kinematic structure;
              (3) <i>Binding</i>: bind the skeleton and bones via non-parametric partwise motion matching, synthesizing
              novel bone motions by matching, retrieving, and blending existing ones.
              Collectively, these three steps enable us to compress the Level of Dynamics of the reconstructed Gaussian
              sequences into compact skelebones that are both controllable and expressive.
              We validate our approach on both synthetic and real-world datasets, achieving significant improvements in
              reanimation performance across unseen poses—with <b class="metric-good">17.3%</b> PSNR gains over Linear Blend Skinning (LBS)
              and <b class="metric-good">21.7%</b> over Bag-of-Bones (BoB)—while maintaining excellent reconstruction fidelity,
              particularly for characters exhibiting complex non-rigid surface dynamics.
              Our Partwise Motion Matching algorithm demonstrates strong generalization to both Gaussian and mesh
              representations, even under low-data regimes (~1000 frames), achieving <b class="metric-good">48.4%</b> RMSE improvement over
              robust LBS and outperforming GRU- and MLP-based learning methods by <b class="metric-good">>20%</b>.
              Code will be made publicly available for research purposes.
            </p>

      var videos = document.querySelectorAll("video");
      for (var i = 0; i < videos.length; i++) {
        var video = videos[i];
        if (video.closest("#teaser-gallery-videos") || video.closest(".method-showcase")) continue;
        var source = getVideoSource(video);
        if (!source || !source.dataset.src) continue;

        video.autoplay = false;
        video.preload = "none";
        video.removeAttribute("autoplay");
        if (source.getAttribute("src")) {
          source.removeAttribute("src");
          video.load();
        }
      }
    }

    function setVideoSource(video, enabled) {
      var source = getVideoSource(video);
      if (!source || !source.dataset.src) return;

      if (enabled) {
        if (source.getAttribute("src") !== source.dataset.src) {
          source.setAttribute("src", source.dataset.src);
          video.load();
        }
      } else if (source.getAttribute("src")) {
        source.removeAttribute("src");
        video.load();
      }
    }

    function playDeferredVideo(video) {
      var rate = parseFloat(video.dataset.playbackRate || "1");
      video.playbackRate = !isNaN(rate) && rate > 0 ? rate : 1;

      var playPromise = video.play();
      if (playPromise && typeof playPromise.then === "function") {
        playPromise.then(null, function () {});
      }
    }

    function initTeaserGalleryVideos() {
      var gallery = document.getElementById("teaser-gallery-videos");
      if (!gallery) return;

      var videos = gallery.querySelectorAll("video");
      if (!("IntersectionObserver" in window)) {
        loadVideosIn(gallery);
        return;
      }

      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
          var video = entries[i].target;
          if (entries[i].isIntersecting) {
            setVideoSource(video, true);
            video.autoplay = true;
            video.preload = "metadata";
            playDeferredVideo(video);
          } else {
            video.autoplay = false;
            video.pause();
          }
        }
      }, {
        rootMargin: "360px 0px",
        threshold: 0.01,
      });

      for (var i = 0; i < videos.length; i++) {
        observer.observe(videos[i]);
      }
    }

    function loadVideosIn(container) {
      var videos = container.querySelectorAll("video");
      for (var i = 0; i < videos.length; i++) {
        var video = videos[i];
        setVideoSource(video, true);
        video.autoplay = true;
        video.preload = "metadata";
        if (video.muted) {
          playDeferredVideo(video);
        }
      }
    }

    function unloadVideosIn(container) {
      var videos = container.querySelectorAll("video");
      for (var i = 0; i < videos.length; i++) {
        var video = videos[i];
        video.autoplay = false;
        video.pause();
        if (video.readyState > 0) {
          video.currentTime = 0;
        }
        video.preload = "none";
        setVideoSource(video, false);
      }
    }

    function getDeferredResultSection(element) {
      return element.closest("#vto-section, #deformingthings4d-section, #actorshq-section");
    }

    function isResultSectionMediaActive(element) {
      var section = getDeferredResultSection(element);
      return !section || section.dataset.mediaActive === "true";
    }

    function syncPageVideos(page, shouldPlay) {
      if (shouldPlay && !isResultSectionMediaActive(page)) {
        shouldPlay = false;
      }

      if (!shouldPlay) {
        unloadVideosIn(page);
        return;
      }

      var videos = page.querySelectorAll("video");
      var processedBodies = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < videos.length; i++) {
        var sectionBody = videos[i].closest(".result-accordion-body");
        if (!sectionBody) {
          loadVideosIn(videos[i].parentElement);
        } else if (processedBodies.indexOf(sectionBody) === -1) {
          processedBodies.push(sectionBody);
          if (sectionBody.parentElement.classList.contains("is-open")) {
            loadVideosIn(sectionBody);
          } else {
            unloadVideosIn(sectionBody);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    function createResultAccordion(page, marker) {
      var title = marker.textContent.trim();
      var accordion = document.createElement("div");
      var button = document.createElement("button");
      var body = document.createElement("div");

      accordion.className = "result-accordion";
      button.className = "result-accordion-toggle";
      button.type = "button";
      button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      button.innerHTML =
        '<span class="result-accordion-toggle-spacer" aria-hidden="true"></span>' +
        '<span class="result-accordion-title">' + title + '</span>' +
        '<span class="result-accordion-hint">Click to expand</span>';
      body.className = "result-accordion-body";

      accordion.appendChild(button);
      accordion.appendChild(body);
      page.insertBefore(accordion, marker);
      page.removeChild(marker);

      while (accordion.nextElementSibling && !accordion.nextElementSibling.classList.contains("mb-4")) {
        body.appendChild(accordion.nextElementSibling);
      }

      button.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var open = !accordion.classList.contains("is-open");
        accordion.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
        button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
        button.querySelector(".result-accordion-hint").textContent = open ? "Click to collapse" : "Click to expand";

        if (open && page.classList.contains("is-active") && isResultSectionMediaActive(page)) {
          loadVideosIn(body);
        } else {
          unloadVideosIn(body);
        }
      });
    }

    function initExpandableResultSections() {
      var pages = document.querySelectorAll(".cloth-page, .animal-page, .actor-page");
      for (var i = 0; i < pages.length; i++) {
        var marker = findDirectSectionMarker(pages[i]);
        while (marker) {
          createResultAccordion(pages[i], marker);
          marker = findDirectSectionMarker(pages[i]);
        }
      }
    }

    function findDirectSectionMarker(page) {
      for (var i = 0; i < page.children.length; i++) {
        if (page.children[i].classList.contains("mb-4")) {
          return page.children[i];
        }
      }
      return null;
    }

    function getActiveResultPage(section) {
      return section.querySelector(".cloth-page.is-active, .animal-page.is-active, .actor-page.is-active");
    }

    function setObservedMode(section, button, enabled) {
      var panel = section.querySelector("[data-observed-panel]");
      if (!panel) return;

      section.classList.toggle("is-observed-mode", enabled);
      panel.classList.toggle("is-active", enabled);
      button.classList.toggle("is-active", enabled);
      button.textContent = enabled ? "Back to Results" : "Show observed motion";

      if (enabled) {
        unloadVideosIn(section);
        if (isResultSectionMediaActive(section)) {
          loadVideosIn(panel);
        }
      } else {
        unloadVideosIn(panel);
        var activePage = getActiveResultPage(section);
        if (activePage) {
          syncPageVideos(activePage, true);
        }
      }
    }

    function syncResultSectionMedia(section) {
      if (!isResultSectionMediaActive(section)) {
        unloadVideosIn(section);
        return;
      }

      if (section.classList.contains("is-observed-mode")) {
        var observedPanel = section.querySelector("[data-observed-panel]");
        if (observedPanel) {
          loadVideosIn(observedPanel);
        }
        return;
      }

      var activePage = getActiveResultPage(section);
      if (activePage) {
        syncPageVideos(activePage, true);
      }
    }

    function initResultSectionMediaObservers() {
      var sections = [
        document.getElementById("vto-section"),
        document.getElementById("deformingthings4d-section"),
        document.getElementById("actorshq-section"),
      ].filter(Boolean);

      for (var i = 0; i < sections.length; i++) {
        sections[i].dataset.mediaActive = "false";
      }

      if (!("IntersectionObserver" in window)) {
        for (var i = 0; i < sections.length; i++) {
          sections[i].dataset.mediaActive = "true";
          syncResultSectionMedia(sections[i]);
        }
        return;
      }

      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
          var section = entries[i].target;
          section.dataset.mediaActive = entries[i].isIntersecting ? "true" : "false";
          syncResultSectionMedia(section);
        }
      }, {
        rootMargin: "700px 0px",
        threshold: 0.01,
      });

      for (var i = 0; i < sections.length; i++) {
        observer.observe(sections[i]);
      }
    }

    function initObservedMotionToggles() {
      var buttons = document.querySelectorAll("[data-observed-toggle]");
      for (var i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++) {
        buttons[i].addEventListener("click", function () {
          var section = document.getElementById(this.dataset.observedToggle);
          if (!section) return;

          setObservedMode(section, this, !section.classList.contains("is-observed-mode"));
        });
      }
    }

    function initClothPager() {
      var section = document.getElementById("vto-section");
      if (!section) return;

      var pages = section.querySelectorAll(".cloth-page");
      var prevBtn = document.getElementById("cloth-page-prev");
      var nextBtn = document.getElementById("cloth-page-next");
      var indicator = document.getElementById("cloth-page-indicator");
      if (!pages.length || !prevBtn || !nextBtn || !indicator) return;

      var current = 0;
      var clothNameMap = {
        hood_video_tshirt_shape00_91_33: "Tshirt1",
        hood_video_tshirt_shape00_91_36: "Tshirt2",
        hood_video_tshirt_shape00_91_38: "Tshirt3",
        hood_video_dress_shape00_91_38: "Dress1",
        hood_video_dress_shape00_91_61: "Dress2",
      };

      function showPage(index) {
        current = (index + pages.length) % pages.length;
        for (var i = 0; i < pages.length; i++) {
          var active = i === current;
          pages[i].classList.toggle("is-active", active);
          syncPageVideos(pages[i], active);
        }
        var rawName = pages[current].dataset.cloth || "unknown";
        var name = clothNameMap[rawName] || rawName;
        indicator.textContent = (current + 1) + " / " + pages.length + " - " + name;
      }

      prevBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        showPage(current - 1);
      });

      nextBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        showPage(current + 1);
      });

      showPage(0);
    }

    function initAnimalPager() {
      var section = document.getElementById("deformingthings4d-section");
      if (!section) return;

      var pages = section.querySelectorAll(".animal-page");
      var prevBtn = document.getElementById("animal-page-prev");
      var nextBtn = document.getElementById("animal-page-next");
      var indicator = document.getElementById("animal-page-indicator");
      if (!pages.length || !prevBtn || !nextBtn || !indicator) return;

      var current = 0;

      function showPage(index) {
        current = (index + pages.length) % pages.length;
        for (var i = 0; i < pages.length; i++) {
          var active = i === current;
          pages[i].classList.toggle("is-active", active);
          syncPageVideos(pages[i], active);
        }
        var animalName = pages[current].dataset.animal || "unknown";
        indicator.textContent = (current + 1) + " / " + pages.length + " - " + animalName;
      }

      prevBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        showPage(current - 1);
      });

      nextBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        showPage(current + 1);
      });

      showPage(0);
    }

    function initActorPager() {
      var section = document.getElementById("actorshq-section");
      if (!section) return;

      var pages = section.querySelectorAll(".actor-page");
      var prevBtn = document.getElementById("actor-page-prev");
      var nextBtn = document.getElementById("actor-page-next");
      var indicator = document.getElementById("actor-page-indicator");
      if (!pages.length || !prevBtn || !nextBtn || !indicator) return;

      var current = 0;
      var actorNameMap = {
        actor01_seq01_c106: "Actor01 Seq01",
        actor02_seq01_c159: "Actor02 Seq01",
        actor04_seq02_c159: "Actor04 Seq02",
      };

      function showPage(index) {
        current = (index + pages.length) % pages.length;
        for (var i = 0; i < pages.length; i++) {
          var active = i === current;
          pages[i].classList.toggle("is-active", active);
          syncPageVideos(pages[i], active);
        }
        var rawName = pages[current].dataset.actor || "unknown";
        var actorName = actorNameMap[rawName] || rawName;
        indicator.textContent = (current + 1) + " / " + pages.length + " - " + actorName;
      }

      prevBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        showPage(current - 1);
      });

      nextBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        showPage(current + 1);
      });

      showPage(0);
    }

    prepareDeferredVideos();
    initTeaserGalleryVideos();
    initExpandableResultSections();
    initObservedMotionToggles();
    initResultSectionMediaObservers();
    initClothPager();
    initAnimalPager();
    initActorPager();

    function toggleMoreVideos() {
      var moreVideos = document.getElementById("more-videos");
      var btn = event.target;

      if (moreVideos.style.display === "none") {
        moreVideos.style.display = "flex";
        btn.textContent = "Hide more results";
      } else {
        moreVideos.style.display = "none";
        btn.textContent = "Check out more results";
      }

        btn.textContent = "Check out more results";
      }
    }
